reason: The reciprocal-multiplication shift is too small: SHIFT = 34 with MULTIPLIER = ceil(2^34/7) gives error n*5/(7*2^34) ≈ 0.179 for n near 2^32, which exceeds the 1/7 fractional gap; e.g. n = 4294967291 (n mod 7 = 6) yields quotient 613566756 instead of 613566755. A shift of 35 (or a properly rounded multiplier) would be required for exactness over all uint32 values.
